title: Web & Mobile Apps
tagline: Small apps that run in any browser, on a phone, tablet or computer. Open one, then add it to your Home Screen.
foot: Each app is one HTML file that runs in your browser. Nothing you make is uploaded. Code licensed under GPL-3.0.

apps.name: HTML App Generator
apps.tagline: Make single-file apps like these: fill in a short spec, watch the app take shape, download it.

apps.name: Pegboard Iso Lab
apps.tagline: Design 3D-illusion bead patterns: isometric shapes, tessellations, seeded terrain and pipe tiles, on a pegboard.

apps.name: The Civilian's Guide to Milspeak
apps.tagline: A plain-language guide to military ranks, structures, codes and terms.

apps.name: Torah Tutor
apps.tagline: Karaoke-style Torah trope practice: sing along, one word at a time, build from the end, slow it down, loop any part.

apps.name: Seventh
apps.tagline: A short platformer about rest: gather manna for six days, and on the seventh, stop.

apps.name: One Way
apps.tagline: A tiny game: a stick figure, a path, a blank gravestone and one direction.

apps.name: Hex Bead Cubes
apps.tagline: Tumbling-block cube patterns for a hexagonal pegboard, marked off bead by bead as you build.

apps.name: Iso Bead Designer
apps.tagline: Stack cubes and read off a bead chart for a 48 × 38 isometric pegboard.

apps.name: RIT Department Year Planner
apps.tagline: One academic year of recurring tasks, dates and owners for an RIT department, written for roles instead of people.

apps.name: Image, Preserve, Analyze, Report
apps.tagline: A playable digital-forensics case: image, preserve, analyze and report on a real disk image.

readme: **Web & Mobile Apps** gives single-file HTML apps live web addresses, so they open on any phone, tablet or computer and can be added to the Home Screen.
- `src/` holds the published copy of each app, one HTML file each. `site.json` lists them.

- `node tools/cli.js site site.json .` builds a folder for each app: the app (`index.html`), Home Screen icons, `manifest.webmanifest`, and `sw.js`, an offline helper so the Home Screen app opens without a connection. It also builds the front page and this README.
- To add, update or remove an app, follow `AGENTS.md`. It's written for any AI assistant or person. The rules every app follows are in `HOUSE-RULES.md`.
The code in this repository is licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0 (see `LICENSE`). Anything the apps credit to others, such as colour data or trademarks, keeps its own terms.
